'''Coconut palms''' are a type of [[above ground]] [[tree]]. They can be found in dry areas of any [[tropical]] biome. Like the overwhelming majority of overland trees, palm [[carpenter|wood]] is brown and produces brown products.

Coconut palms produce coconuts that can be harvested by setting up a gathering [[zone]]. Coconuts are edible raw or cooked, but cannot be brewed. Unlike most other fruit trees, coconuts do not have seeds (technically the coconut itself is a seed, but it isn't set as such in the raws).

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] coconut palms for their ''leaves''.
